headword: {非常階段|ひじょうかいだん}

definitions.explanation: A staircase designated for use during emergencies such as fires or earthquakes. Typically found on the exterior or in enclosed stairwells of buildings.

examples.japanese: {非常階段|ひじょうかいだん}から{避難|ひなん}する。
examples.english: To evacuate via the emergency staircase.

examples.japanese: {非常階段|ひじょうかいだん}の{場所|ばしょ}を{確認|かくにん}しておく。
examples.english: To check where the emergency staircase is located in advance.

examples.japanese: {火災|かさい}{発生|はっせい}{時|じ}はエレベーターを{使|つか}わず{非常階段|ひじょうかいだん}で{降|お}りてください。
examples.english: In case of fire, please use the emergency staircase instead of the elevator.

notes: Composed of {非常|ひじょう} (emergency) + {階段|かいだん} (staircase). In Japan, building codes ({建築基準法|けんちくきじゅんほう}) require {非常階段|ひじょうかいだん} in buildings above a certain size. Common collocations: {非常階段|ひじょうかいだん}で{避難|ひなん}する (to evacuate via the emergency stairs), {非常階段|ひじょうかいだん}の{位置|いち} (location of the emergency stairs). Part of the {非常〜|ひじょう〜} (emergency ~) compound family: {非常口|ひじょうぐち} (emergency exit), {非常|ひじょう}ベル (emergency bell), {非常|ひじょう}{食|しょく} (emergency food).
